ddl.federation_links:
CREATE TABLE `federation_links` (
  `id` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `source_tenant_id` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `source_entity_id` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `target_tenant_id` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `target_entity_id` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `relation_type` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `label` varchar(200) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `reason` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `created_by` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `reviewed_by` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` varchar(40) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` varchar(40) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_federation_edge` (`source_tenant_id`,`source_entity_id`,`target_tenant_id`,`target_entity_id`,`relation_type`),
  KEY `ix_federation_source` (`source_tenant_id`,`source_entity_id`),
  KEY `ix_federation_target` (`target_tenant_id`,`target_entity_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
ddl.ontology_task_queue:
CREATE TABLE `ontology_task_queue` (
  `job_id` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `tenant_id` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `kind` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `entity_id` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `principal_json` longtext COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `args_json` longtext COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(24) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `attempts` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `max_attempts` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '3',
  `available_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `lease_token` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `lease_until` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `active_key` char(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_error` varchar(500) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`job_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `active_key` (`active_key`),
  KEY `idx_queue_ready` (`status`,`available_at`,`lease_until`),
  KEY `idx_queue_tenant` (`tenant_id`,`entity_id`,`status`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
ddl.sec_application_credentials:
CREATE TABLE `sec_application_credentials` (
  `id` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `application_id` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `token_hash` char(64) NOT NULL,
  `token_prefix` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `delegate_auth_version` int NOT NULL,
  `expires_at` double NOT NULL,
  `revoked_at` double DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_by` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` double NOT NULL,
  `last_used_at` double DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `token_hash` (`token_hash`),
  KEY `idx_app_credential` (`application_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `sec_application_credentials_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`application_id`) REFERENCES `sec_applications` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
ddl.sec_applications:
CREATE TABLE `sec_applications` (
  `id` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `tenant_id` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(200) NOT NULL,
  `description` varchar(2000) NOT NULL,
  `delegate_user_id` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `enabled` tinyint NOT NULL,
  `version` int NOT NULL,
  `tool_scopes` json NOT NULL,
  `mapping_ids` json NOT NULL,
  `created_by` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` double NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` double NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_app_tenant` (`tenant_id`),
  KEY `delegate_user_id` (`delegate_user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `sec_applications_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`tenant_id`) REFERENCES `sec_tenants` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `sec_applications_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`delegate_user_id`) REFERENCES `sec_users` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
ddl.sec_audit:
CREATE TABLE `sec_audit` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `created_at` double NOT NULL,
  `actor_id` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `actor_username` varchar(80) DEFAULT NULL,
  `tenant_id` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `action` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `resource` varchar(500) NOT NULL,
  `outcome` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `request_id` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `details` longtext NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_audit_tenant` (`tenant_id`,`id`),
  KEY `idx_audit_actor` (`actor_id`,`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=16 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
ddl.sec_grants:
CREATE TABLE `sec_grants` (
  `id` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `user_id` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `tenant_id` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `access` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `reason` varchar(500) NOT NULL,
  `created_by` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` double NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_grant` (`user_id`,`tenant_id`),
  KEY `tenant_id` (`tenant_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `sec_grants_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `sec_users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `sec_grants_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`tenant_id`) REFERENCES `sec_tenants` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
ddl.sec_login_limits:
CREATE TABLE `sec_login_limits` (
  `bucket` char(64) NOT NULL,
  `failures` int NOT NULL,
  `window_start` double NOT NULL,
  `locked_until` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`bucket`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
ddl.sec_sessions:
CREATE TABLE `sec_sessions` (
  `id` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `token_hash` char(64) NOT NULL,
  `csrf_hash` char(64) NOT NULL,
  `user_id` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `tenant_id` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `auth_version` int NOT NULL,
  `created_at` double NOT NULL,
  `last_seen_at` double NOT NULL,
  `expires_at` double NOT NULL,
  `revoked_at` double DEFAULT NULL,
  `user_agent` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `ip_hint` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `token_hash` (`token_hash`),
  KEY `idx_session_user` (`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `sec_sessions_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `sec_users` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
ddl.sec_tenants:
CREATE TABLE `sec_tenants` (
  `id` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `category` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `org_id` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `db_name` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
  `created_at` double NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `db_name` (`db_name`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
ddl.sec_users:
CREATE TABLE `sec_users` (
  `id` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `username` varchar(80) NOT NULL,
  `display_name` varchar(120) NOT NULL,
  `home_tenant_id` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `role` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  `password_hash` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `is_active` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `is_superadmin` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `must_change_password` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `auth_version` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `created_at` double NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` double NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `username` (`username`),
  KEY `idx_user_tenant` (`home_tenant_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `sec_users_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`home_tenant_id`) REFERENCES `sec_tenants` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
